# Martin 2019 primary source

`Martin2019.pdf` is the arXiv version of Gebhard Martin, *Enriques surfaces
with finite automorphism group in positive characteristic*, Algebraic Geometry
**6** (2019), 592--649, doi:
[10.14231/AG-2019-027](https://doi.org/10.14231/AG-2019-027),
[arXiv:1703.08419](https://arxiv.org/abs/1703.08419).

- PDF SHA-256: `7831fbf14ed90f4a30eec68a989dce660724e6384bd1da3f108d373929b905a9`
- arXiv source archive SHA-256:
  `77f30c710719d5f30106604710a644410f956861903a71b9a21792acd2588776`

The Main Theorem on PDF page 3 states the iff classification by the complete
dual graph of all `(-2)`-curves.  Table 1 on PDF pages 4--5 gives the seven
types, automorphism groups, existence characteristics, and moduli.  The source
archive is retained because its labelled graph images provide a legible check
against Kondō's scanned figures; the exact matrix audit uses Shimada's data
below instead of digitizing those images.
